import sqlite3


def connect(path):
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("create table if not exists items(id integer primary key, stock integer, reserved integer)")
    return db


# flowguard: sensor AVAILABLE
def available(db: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> bool:
    row = db.execute("select stock, reserved from items where id = ?", (item_id,)).fetchone()
    return row is not None and row[0] > row[1]


# flowguard: event RESERVED
def reserve(db: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> None:
    db.execute("update items set reserved = reserved + 1 where id = ?", (item_id,))
